This suggests that Cosmic CRF Ltd may not be utilizing its capital as efficiently as its competitors, which could imply lower profitability and growth potential. Additionally, a discounted cash flow analysis indicates an intrinsic value of Rs 1150 per share, significantly below the current market price of Rs 1361 [E36]. This results in a negative margin of safety of -18.3% [E37], suggesting that the stock is currently overvalued.
